isSupported(Context) - Static method in class com.rockchip.uhf.sdk.UhfSdk
SDK-04: never throws, on any device — including one running a platform build that predates this SRS entirely, as long as the SDK's own classes loaded (which requires nothing device- specific: FEATURE_UHF_READER and UhfManager are ordinary compiled-in framework classes on any device built from a tree with this patch series, present whether or not a reader is attached — the value returned is what varies, never whether the check itself is safe to make).

U

UhfSdk - Class in com.rockchip.uhf.sdk
SDK-01: the entry point third-party apps build against, distributed as com.rockchip.uhf:uhf-sdk (SDK-01's com.<oem>.uhf:uhf-sdk with the OEM this SRS was written for).
UhfSdkSession - Interface in com.rockchip.uhf.sdk
SDK-01/03/09: the method surface android.hardware.uhf.UhfSession exposes, reproduced as an interface so UhfSdk can hand out either a real, platform-API-backed session (RealUhfSdkSession) or an offline one with no reader and no @SystemApi access (FakeUhfSdkSession) behind the same type.
